chunks.content: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-R1, its open-weights reasoning model with accompanying paper, on 2025-01-20. Its predecessor DeepSeek-V3 (released 2024-12-26) reported training on roughly 2.79 million GPU-hours at a claimed cost of about US$5.6 million, on export-restricted H800 chips. R1's reasoning was produced by reinforcement learning (GRPO), and R1-Zero was trained with no supervised fine-tuning at all. On 2025-01-27, Nvidia lost approximately US$589 billion in market capitalization — at the time the largest single-day loss in stock-market history — with about US$1 trillion erased across the tech complex. Markets repriced the thesis that frontier-AI capex, and therefore Nvidia's demand, is moated by compute scale: an open-weights frontier-class reasoning model had been trained for a fraction of the incumbent cost. US export controls (the H800 restrictions) had forced Chinese labs toward efficiency — scarcity, not preference, drove the economics.
